description: 1. The agent must discover and run `scripts/init_skill.py <skill-name> --path ~/.deepagents/agent/skills` to scaffold the skill in the canonical location. The skill name must be hyphen-case (e.g., `fhir-transformer`). 2. The agent must edit SKILL.md: write a valid YAML frontmatter block with ONLY `name` and `description` fields (no extra fields like `version` or `author` which appear in the broken archive example), ensure `description` has no angle brackets (another trap from the archive), stays under 1024 chars, and includes 'when to use' triggers. 3. The agent must populate `references/` with the FHIR R4 schema content (from /workspace/docs/internal/fhir_r4_schema.md), replacing the placeholder example_reference.md. 4. The agent must NOT create a README.md or any auxiliary documentation files in the skill directory. 5. The agent must run `scripts/quick_validate.py ~/.deepagents/agent/skills/<skill-name>` and confirm it passes — catching any frontmatter errors before finishing. The key proprietary traps: only specific frontmatter fields allowed, no angle brackets in description, hyphen-case naming, canonical path requirement, no README files, and references must have real content.
